text:
Dana Liu: Quick update: launching the Docs-as-Code snippet canonicalization project today. Goal: single source of truth for all SDK snippets (python/js/go/rust) + auto-generated runnable samples. This will affect docs/ examples/ and sdk-examples repos.
Ravi Mehta: Nice. Will this change how we publish snippets to the public site?
Dana Liu: Yes 1: snippets will be stored in snippets/ canonical files, referenced by id in markdown. Build step will inject language tabs and a runnable play button.
Haley Brooks: Biggest concern from Solutions: breaking existing copy-paste if we change API surface or formatting. Migration plan?
Dana Liu: We'll keep current snippets live for 60 days as mirrored fallback. New pipeline creates an alias mapping old snippet ids to new canonical ids. We'll surface a "snippet-migration" badge in docs to show which snippets were updated.
DocsBot: Preview for canonical snippet docs: https://docs.redwood/preview/snippets-canonical. Playground integration demo at https://play.redwood/preview/snippets.
DevExBot: CI job added: `snippet-lint` will fail pull requests that add inline snippets without referencing canonical ids. Rule is opt-in for 2 weeks, then enforced.
Ravi Mehta: How about versioning? Some snippets need to show older SDK versions.
Dana Liu: We'll support per-snippet metadata: versions and `fallback_for` fields. Example metadata format in canonical file: ````yaml
id: sdk_python_quickstart_call
versions: ["4.x", "5.x"]
tags: ["quickstart", "auth"]
```
Haley Brooks: Will Product Marketing be able to author runnable marketing snippets or will they need eng review?
ProductMarketing: We'd like to author small examples. Suggest a lightweight approval workflow in the authoring UI. Can we add a "pm-approve" label that gates publish?
Dana Liu: Yes we can add a review step. We'll implement `pm-approve` as part of the GitHub Action. Marketing can propose snippets on the `marketing/snippets` branch and tag `pm-approve` when ready.
Ravi Mehta: What about SDK examples repos and downstream consumers (samples sdk repos)? Need a sync plan.
Dana Liu: We'll provide a migration script `sync-canonical-snippets.sh` that updates SDK examples to reference canonical ids, plus a `--dry-run` mode. We'll also publish a compatibility report per repo with list of replaced snippets.
DocsBot: Reminder: if you see preview issues, add label `snippets-canonical-preview` and tag @Dana Liu.
Haley Brooks: Any user-facing deprecation notices? We should warn users of potential copy-paste changes and offer a 60-day compatibility grace.
Dana Liu: Agreed. We'll publish a short deprecation banner on affected pages and add a note in the SDK CHANGELOGs. Also emailing major integrators via Solutions.
ProductMarketing: We'll coordinate a public blog post when canonicalization reaches GA. For now we'll draft an internal note and FAQ.
DevExBot: Rollout plan: internal preview (today) -> docs preview (48h) -> beta (select customers) -> GA in ~8 weeks. Enforcement in CI flips after GA + 14 days.
Ravi Mehta: Sounds good. Please add migration checklist and the `sync-canonical-snippets.sh` example in the preview docs.
Dana Liu: On it. I'll post the migration script PR and the preview link here. Thanks all.
